CALAMITY-BRITTLE_POWER.title: Brittle
CALAMITY-BRITTLE_POWER.description: Take additional damage from each Attack.
CALAMITY-BRITTLE_POWER.smartDescription: Take [blue]{Amount}[/blue] additional damage from each Attack.
CALAMITY-SENSITIVE_POWER.title: Sensitive
CALAMITY-SENSITIVE_POWER.description: Whenever this loses HP, it loses more.
CALAMITY-SENSITIVE_POWER.smartDescriptio: Whenever you lose HP, lose [blue]{Amount}[/blue] more.
CALAMITY-SEIZED_POWER.title: Seized
CALAMITY-SEIZED_POWER.description: The next card played costs more. Removed after a card is played.
CALAMITY-SEIZED_POWER.smartDescription: Your next card costs [blue]{Amount}[/blue] more. Removed after you play a card.
CALAMITY-BACKLASH_POWER.title: Backlash
CALAMITY-BACKLASH_POWER.description: Whenever this loses Strength, it permanently regains part of it.
CALAMITY-BACKLASH_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever this loses [gold]Strength[/gold], it permanently regains [blue]{Amount}%[/blue] of it, rounded up.
CALAMITY-DAMP_POWER.title: Damp
CALAMITY-DAMP_POWER.description: The next Attack deals less damage. Removed after an Attack is played.
CALAMITY-DAMP_POWER.smartDescription: Your next Attack deals [blue]{Amount}[/blue] less damage. Removed after you play an Attack.
CALAMITY-RAGE_THRESHOLD_POWER.title: Rage Threshold
CALAMITY-RAGE_THRESHOLD_POWER.descriptio: The first time this drops to half HP, it gains Strength.
CALAMITY-RAGE_THRESHOLD_POWER.smartDescr: The first time this drops to half HP, it gains [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
CALAMITY-SPLIT_POWER.title: Split
CALAMITY-SPLIT_POWER.description: Each time this loses a quarter of its Max HP, a slime splits off.
CALAMITY-SPLIT_POWER.smartDescription: Each time this loses a quarter of its Max HP, a slime splits off. [blue]{Amount}[/blue] {Amount:plural:split|splits} left.
CALAMITY-INFERNO_POWER.title: Inferno
CALAMITY-INFERNO_POWER.description: Every 3rd turn, shuffles Burns into each player's draw pile.
CALAMITY-INFERNO_POWER.smartDescription: In [blue]{Amount}[/blue] {Amount:plural:turn|turns}, shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Burn[/gold] into each player's draw pile. Repeats every 3 turns.
CALAMITY-MODE_SHIFT_POWER.title: Mode Shift
CALAMITY-MODE_SHIFT_POWER.description: After taking enough damage, gains Block and Thorns for 2 turns.
CALAMITY-MODE_SHIFT_POWER.smartDescripti: After taking [blue]{Amount}[/blue] more damage, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and [blue]{ThornsPower}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold] for 2 turns. The threshold rises each time.
CALAMITY-SECOND_WIND_POWER.title: Second Wind
CALAMITY-SECOND_WIND_POWER.description: At half HP, removes its debuffs and gains Strength and Plating.
CALAMITY-SECOND_WIND_POWER.smartDescript: At half HP, remove all debuffs and gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{PlatingPower}[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold].
CALAMITY-STASIS_POWER.title: Stasis
CALAMITY-STASIS_POWER.description: Takes the most expensive card from each player's hand at the start of combat and every 4 turns. They return when this drops to half HP or dies.
CALAMITY-STASIS_POWER.smartDescription: Takes the most expensive card from each player's hand at the start of combat and every 4 turns. They return when this drops to half HP or dies.
CALAMITY-MEGA_DEBUFF_POWER.title: Mega Debuff
CALAMITY-MEGA_DEBUFF_POWER.description: On its 3rd turn, makes every player Vulnerable, Weak and Frail.
CALAMITY-SQUARE_AND_CIRCLE_POWER.title: Square and Circle
CALAMITY-SQUARE_AND_CIRCLE_POWER.descrip: Every 2nd turn, gains Strength and shuffles Dazed into each player's draw pile.
CALAMITY-SQUARE_AND_CIRCLE_POWER.smartDe: Every 2nd turn, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] into each player's draw pile.
CALAMITY-TIME_WARP_POWER.title: Time Warp
CALAMITY-TIME_WARP_POWER.description: Counts every card the party plays. On the last of each count, gains Strength and ends that player's turn.
CALAMITY-TIME_WARP_POWER.smartDescriptio: After [blue]{Amount}[/blue] more {Amount:plural:card|cards} played by the party, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and end that player's turn. Resets to [blue]{Cards}[/blue].
CALAMITY-REBIRTH_POWER.title: Rebirth
CALAMITY-REBIRTH_POWER.description: The first time this would die, it rises again, cleansed.
CALAMITY-REBIRTH_POWER.smartDescription: The first time this would die, it removes its debuffs and returns with [blue]{Amount}%[/blue] of its Max HP.
